pages.title: Issues | Vicente Gonzalez for U.S. Congress
pages.text:
## Vicente Gonzalez is fighting to take our South Texas values to Congress — ensuring we stand by our promise to veterans, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and continue to build our economy, from the new medical school to growing engineering programs, ensuring that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.
Click each issue to learn more.
Medicare & Social Security
A promise made should be a promise kept. Strengthening and protecting Social Security and Medicare for our seniors is a promise we must keep.
- Expand social security to keep up with inflation and cost of living adjustments.
- Strengthen and improve Medicare.
- Oppose Republican efforts to cut funding and oppose privatization of these safety nets.
Education is our society’s greatest equalizer. I will fight for the education our children need to get ahead.
- Fully fund pre-kindergarten and local Head Start programs.
- Help our college students graduate debt free.
- Support the new medical school at UTRGV and expanding engineering programs.
Jobs and Standing Up for South Texas
I will fight for good paying jobs to build our local economies and grow the middle class.
- Support the creation of quality higher wage jobs.
- Strengthen trade ties along the Texas-Mexico border.
- Invest today for the infrastructure we need tomorrow (roads, water, power grid.)
- Cut bureaucratic red-tape that burdens small business owners and job-creators.
- Fight against harmful political rhetoric that casts negative stereotypes on our community hurting our local economy.
Veterans fought for us, its our duty to fight for them. It’s time to stop the excuses and fulfill our promise to all who have worn our nation’s uniform.
- Fight to create a full-service VA hospital in the Rio Grande Valley.
- Ensure our heroes have quality jobs when they transition to our civilian workforce.
- Increase funding for mental health services and quality health care.
Keeping America Safe
America is the land of the free and home of the brave. I support a strong Military and local first responders that keep our country and families safe.
- Increase investments and resources for local law enforcement and first responders.
- Combat criminal elements crossing the border with smart and thoughtful border security.
- Maintain a strong military to remain the leading force for global defense and protection.
- Increase investment in national security and counterterrorism efforts, while safe-guarding our civil rights and liberties.
Increasing Access & Affordability of Healthcare
Healthcare should be treated as a basic human right.
- Strengthen and improve the Affordable Care Act.
- Increase Medicaid reimbursements for our family doctors.
- Support extension of the 1115 Healthcare Transformation Waiver.
- Lower prescription drug prices.
Standing Up For Women & Families
I will fight for the women in our families because when we stand-up for and take care of the women in our families, the whole family is stronger.
- Support equal pay for equal work for women.
- Support paid family and maternity leave.
- Increase funding for critical health care and family planning services for women.
- Support passage of a living wage.
We need to fix our broken immigration system with common-sense and compassionate reform that doesn’t tear families apart.
- Support compassionate immigration reform with a pathway to earned citizenship.
- Support passage of the federal DREAM Act.
- Support the policies of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA).
Medicare & Social Security
Medicare and Social Security are solemn promises that must be honored. After a lifetime of work, seniors deserve the peace of mind that they will have a modest level of security to depend on.
These programs have worked, and worked well. That is why I will oppose risky efforts to privatize Social Security or turn Medicare into a voucher system.
As Congressman I will work to address the long term funding challenges of Social Security, while fighting to ensure the hard earned benefits of seniors keep pace with the rising cost of living, medical care and prescription drugs.
Education is the advice of our parents and grandparents, and they know what they’re talking about. In today’s information economy, a quality education is a necessity. Education is required to get ahead in life, compete for higher paying jobs, and to expand our innovation and creativity as a workforce to compete on a global scale.
As Congressman, I will fight to protect Head Start and pre-K programs that ensure children enter kindergarten ready to learn. I will work to increase investment in technology so that our children are not left behind by a digital divide. I will push for affordable access to higher education so our future leaders are not burdened with insurmountable college debt.
That is why I propose tuition-free higher learning for the first two-years after high school. Congressman Hinojosa, as well as the leader of our state legislative delegation, Senator Juan “Chuy” Hinojosa, have been instrumental in expanding graduate programs in South Texas, including engineering and the new Medical School.
I will work to build on their legacy to continue providing quality educational experiences for our students, while finding new solutions to make college more affordable and reduce student debt.
Jobs and Standing Up for South Texas
Our economy in South Texas continues to diversify and grow, from trade to health care, agriculture, manufacturing, innovation and more. As Congressman, I will take on any politician who casts negative stereotypes on border communities that hurt our business environment.
At the same time, I’ll work across the aisle and with anyone who understands that trade and our relationship with Mexico are job creators for America. I will fight for jobs, and I will fight for higher wages and salaries so that our families not only provide for themselves, but also care for themselves.
That means making child care more affordable, standing by family medical leave, and ensuring that affordable health care is within the reach of every working Texan.
I stand by our local veterans who have never stopped fighting to bring a VA hospital to the Valley to honor the sacrifices of all South Texas men and women who have served our nation proudly. Their efforts have led to vastly expanded health care services in South Texas, but much more still needs to be done. As Congressman, I will honor our nation’s debt to our veterans by fighting for:
- A full VA Hospital in South Texas.
- Reform and modernization at the VA to ensure efficient and high-quality care for all veterans.
- Increased mental health services, including treatment, counseling and support, for those suffering from PTSD and their families
- Increased support for military families, especially those who must serve as caretakers for injured and disabled veterans.
- Strong GI Bill benefits to ensure every veteran has access to higher education and a chance to serve our nation as a civilian just as they did in uniform.
- Expanded civilian workforce opportunities for our service-members returning from the armed forces.
Keeping America Safe
America is the land of the free, and I support a strong military and national defense to ensure we stay that way. Today we face various enemies who play by different rules, and we must stay vigilant while honoring the Constitutional rights of US citizens. As Congressman, I will support the critical efforts to keep our country and families safe by:
- Investing in first responders at the community level.
- Maintaining smart border security, increased security at our ports and a more collaborative and accountable relationship with Mexico.
- Keeping our military strong and continuing to remain a leading force in global defense and protection.
Increasing Access & Affordability of Healthcare

Today we face various enemies who play by different rules, and we must stay vigilant while honoring the Constitutional rights of US citizens. pages.text:
WATCH THE STORY
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
Vicente is a lifetime South Texan who lives and works in McAllen. Vicente is married to Lorena Saenz Gonzalez, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools, respectively.
Support the Cause
Lend us a hand.
Your contribution will provide the needed resources to lead a successful campaign to provide leadership and experience to Texas's 34th District!

pages.text:
top of page
## The issues we fight for.
As an attorney, Vicente fought to give working families and consumers a strong voice in court. Now, he seeks to be the fighter and the strong voice that South Texans need in Congress.
## Education
Education is our society's greatest equalizer. I will fight for the education our children need to get ahead.
​Fully fund pre-kindergarten and local Head Start programs.
Help our college students graduate debt free.
Support the new medical school at UTRGV and expanding engineering programs.
## Medicare and Social Security
A promise made should be a promise kept. Strengthening and protecting Social Security and Medicare for our seniors is a promise we must keep.
​ Expand social security to keep up with inflation and cost of living adjustments.
Strengthen and improve Medicare.
Oppose Republican efforts to cut funding and oppose privatization of these safety nets.
## Jobs and Standing Up for South Texas
I will fight for good paying jobs to build our local economies and grow the middle class.
Support the creation of quality higher wage jobs.
Strengthen trade ties along the Texas-Mexico border.
Invest today for the infrastructure we need tomorrow (roads, water, power grid.)
Cut bureaucratic red-tape that burdens small business owners and job-creators.
Fight against harmful political rhetoric that casts negative stereotypes on our community hurting our local economy.
## Veterans
Veterans fought for us, its our duty to fight for them. It's time to stop the excuses and fulfill our promise to all who have worn our nation's uniform.
​Fight to create a full-service VA hospital in the Rio Grande Valley.
Ensure our heroes have quality jobs when they transition to our civilian workforce.
Increase funding for mental health services and quality health care.
## Keeping America Safe
America is the land of the free and home of the brave. I support a strong Military and local first responders that keep our country and families safe.
​ Increase investments and resources for local law enforcement and first responders.
Combat criminal elements crossing the border with smart and thoughtful border security.
Maintain a strong military to remain the leading force for global defense and protection.
Increase investment in national security and counterterrorism efforts, while safe-guarding our civil rights and liberties.
## Increasing Access & Affordability of Healthcare
Healthcare should be treated as a basic human right.
Strengthen and improve the Affordable Care Act.
Increase Medicaid reimbursements for our family doctors.
Support extension of the 1115 Healthcare Transformation Waiver.
Lower prescription drug prices.
## Standing Up For Women & Families
I will fight for the women in our families because when we stand-up for and take care of the women in our families, the whole family is stronger.
​ Support equal pay for equal work for women.
Support paid family and maternity leave.
Increase funding for critical health care and family planning services for women.
Support passage of a living wage.
## Immigration
We need to fix our broken immigration system with common-sense and compassionate reform that doesn't tear families apart.​
Support compassionate immigration reform with a pathway to earned citizenship.
Support passage of the federal DREAM Act.
Support the policies of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA).

pages.title: Issues – Vicente Gonzalez
pages.text:
## Issues
Families across South Texas are feeling the pressure of rising everyday costs. From groceries and housing to energy and transportation, increased expenses have made it harder for working families to stay financially secure.
Vicente Gonzalez believes that people who work hard should be able to afford a stable and dignified life. Addressing affordability means focusing on practical solutions that reduce financial strain and help families keep more of what they earn.
The impact of rising costs goes beyond household budgets. It affects education, healthcare decisions, and long-term financial planning for families throughout the district.
Vicente is committed to supporting policies that promote economic stability, protect working families, and ensure South Texans are not left behind as costs continue to rise.
Seniors across South Texas deserve security, stability, and peace of mind after a lifetime of hard work. Many older residents rely on earned benefits and essential services to maintain independence and dignity in retirement.
Vicente Gonzalez understands that protecting seniors means safeguarding programs that provide financial security and access to healthcare. These benefits are not privileges — they are commitments made to those who contributed to our communities and economy for decades.
Beyond financial security, seniors also face challenges related to healthcare access, prescription affordability, and long-term care support. Addressing these issues requires steady leadership and a clear focus on protecting vulnerable populations.
Vicente remains committed to strengthening support systems for seniors, ensuring they receive the care, respect, and protection they deserve throughout their retirement years.
## General Election November 3, 2026
Women across South Texas play a vital role in families, workplaces, and communities. Protecting women’s rights means ensuring equal opportunity, economic security, and access to essential healthcare services.
Vicente Gonzalez supports policies that promote fairness, protect individual freedoms, and strengthen protections that allow women to make informed decisions about their lives and futures. Equal rights and equal opportunity are fundamental to a strong and stable society.
Women’s economic security is also closely tied to workplace protections, fair wages, and access to quality education and career pathways. Strengthening these areas supports families and builds stronger communities throughout the district.
Vicente is committed to standing for policies that protect rights, expand opportunity, and ensure women across South Texas are treated with dignity, fairness, and respect.
Education plays a critical role in shaping the future of South Texas. Strong schools provide children and young people with the tools they need to succeed and contribute meaningfully to their communities.
Vicente Gonzalez believes every student deserves access to a quality education, regardless of background or zip code. Investing in education means investing in opportunity.
Supporting educators, improving resources, and creating pathways for student success are essential parts of building a stronger education system.
Vicente remains focused on policies that strengthen schools and prepare future generations for success in an evolving world.
Veterans have made tremendous sacrifices in service to our country. Honoring that service requires more than words — it requires meaningful support and long-term commitment.
Vicente Gonzalez is dedicated to ensuring veterans and their families have access to the benefits, healthcare, and resources they deserve. Those who served should be able to transition successfully into civilian life with dignity and security.
Many veterans face challenges related to healthcare, employment, and housing. Addressing these issues is a responsibility that should be met with seriousness and respect.
Vicente is committed to standing with veterans by supporting programs and policies that recognize their service and provide real, lasting assistance.
Access to affordable, quality healthcare is essential for individuals and families to thrive. In South Texas, many communities still face challenges when it comes to availability, affordability, and reliable care.
Vicente Gonzalez supports a healthcare system that works for everyone — whether someone lives in an urban center or a rural community. No family should have to choose between getting medical care and meeting basic needs.
Healthcare is not only about treatment, but also prevention, mental health services, and long-term care. Strong healthcare systems provide peace of mind and protect families from unexpected financial hardship.
Vicente remains focused on strengthening healthcare access and supporting solutions that put patients and families first.
Strong job growth and economic opportunity are essential for the long-term prosperity of South Texas. Families and local businesses depend on a stable economy that creates pathways for success and upward mobility.
Vicente Gonzalez supports efforts that encourage job creation, strengthen small businesses, and invest in industries that bring sustainable growth to the region. A healthy local economy provides opportunity not only for workers, but for entire communities.
Economic opportunity means more than employment — it means access to training, skills development, and career advancement that allow individuals to build secure futures for themselves and their families.
Vicente remains focused on policies that support workforce development, protect local businesses, and create a strong economic foundation for South Texas communities.

pages.title: Accomplishments – Vicente Gonzalez
pages.text:
## A Record of Results
Vicente Gonzalez has worked to advance policies and initiatives that address real needs in South Texas. His focus has remained on practical solutions that improve daily life for families, workers, veterans, and small businesses.
By collaborating with local leaders and community organizations, Vicente has helped support efforts that strengthen economic stability, improve access to services, and protect the interests of the district he represents.
Through ongoing engagement with community leaders, families, and local organizations, Vicente remains focused on understanding challenges and identifying solutions that reflect the priorities of South Texas.
## Key Accomplishments
Hard-working Americans are getting priced out of buying a home, starting a family and saving for retirement. Vicente voted to extend the child tax credit, deliver funding to lower energy and utility costs, reduce prescription drug prices and make it illegal for insurers to charge older people more. As a member of the House Financial Services Committee, he has introduced legislation to make homeownership more accessible and help graduates pay down student loan debt.
Vicente is fighting to deliver economic opportunity for South Texans. He secured permits for LNG projects at the Port of Brownsville and delivered hundreds of millions to deepen the ship channel so our region continues to grow. He has delivered hundreds of millions more for roads, international bridges, drainage and ports across the region so South Texas remains attractive to employers of all sizes.
Vicente knows our economy thrives when our workforce thrives, which is why he continues to support federal Pell Grant funding and expand eligibility for technical education and training programs
Since day one, Vicente has fought to keep Social Security and Medicare strong by opposing tax giveaways to the ultra-wealthy and multinational corporations that threaten funding for programs seniors have paid into their entire lives. In 2024, he shepherded passage of the Social Security Fairness Act — now law — so retirees receive the full value of their retirement benefits. In 2025, he voted against the Big, Ugly Bill, which slashes hundreds of billions from Medicare and millions more from programs seniors rely on like Meals on Wheels.
The proud son of a Korean War veteran and Merchant Marine, Vicente has the utmost respect for our veterans, servicemembers and military families. He is working to prevent the deportation of honorably discharged veterans and expand healthcare options closer to home. He delivered federal funding to update local Veterans of Foreign Wars posts so veterans and community members have safe spaces to gather. He voted to pass the PACT Act so veterans exposed to toxic chemicals during service receive the care they deserve.
